The composition is the mark in motion; the SVG is the mark at rest,
for the frames on either side of it.
flat: the OS frame is a solid colour and every beat runs in Flutter.
Chosen over the `lottie` default because a native overlay means
Swift + Kotlin sources and a native Lottie dependency that no
scaffolder can verify without hardware — and because flat cannot
flash. Tier `lottie` buys motion during engine boot; the composition
is already staged for it if you want to upgrade.
Rule 4: decode before the clock starts, inside the page rather than
in main(). The first ground frame is identical to the native one,
so the wait is invisible; the cap is what keeps a failed decode
